lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Commander. Pepper.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Are you two free?

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Sure, I've got time.
What's wrong?

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: I want to create a certain something,

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: and I'd like to hear your opinions.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Are you talking about "that"?

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: I am.
You mean "that"?
What is "that", exactly?

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Hehe, you don't even know what it is, Commander.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: I would like to put on a simple play

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: for the young patients we have

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: who are hospitalized.
Interesting!

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: I knew you were talking about the play.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: We spoke about it once before,

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: but we haven't made much headway since.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Do you have any specific plans?

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: I was thinking something along the lines of good versus evil,

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: with the hospital standing up against evil bacteria and defeating it.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: The only thing is, I need someone to play the superhero role.
If a superhero is what you need, look no further than Matis.
If you're going to make something action-packed, Cafe Sweety is who you want.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: We can't do that.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Laplace would destroy the hospital,

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Drake would probably want to play the role of the bacteria,

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: and I doubt Maxwell would have any interest in the first place.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: We can't do that.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Milk would end up destroying the whole set,

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Frima would just sleep in the dressing room,

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: and Sugar would probably come on stage while riding her motorcycle.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: If that's how it is, then...

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: I think the Commander would be perfect for the role!

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Can you help?
Of course.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: I knew we could count on you, Commander.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Thanks!

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: I'll let you know when and where we'll be having rehearsals.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Let's all work hard to put on the best show we possibly can.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: All right!
